newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan money rates slightly lower at mid-session.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan money rates slightly lower at mid-session.

text.p: Taiwan's money rates fell slightly at mid-session on Friday as market liquidity remained loose following Thursday's maturation of T$9.3 billion in government treasury bills, dealers said.

The overnight interbank rate was at 5.004 percent against Thursday's 5.039 close, with 30-day commercial paper at 5.20-5.25 against 5.25. Dealers expected the rates to continue their downtrend in the near term.
In the bond market, the 10-year 84/1 bond yield was at 5.6775-5.6800 against 5.6900-5.7050 and the seven-year 85/3 bond yield was at 5.5900. -- Julie Hu (5080815)
